title: Sliding Doors
sub: Two clocks: the film's cuts between Helen's two lives, and the two lives themselves.
notes: The two timelines run in parallel, not in sequence: they begin at the same instant on the platform and are never one chronology.

Numbering: the miss-the-train line (#2, 5, 7, 10, 11) and the catch-the-train line (#3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12) are each numbered in their own order, then interleaved on the right spine so adjacent numbers are roughly the same moment in each life. Nothing is merged.
The film screens the miss first, then rewinds and screens the catch; both are the same instant, so they sit next to each other on the right spine.
The catch-the-train Helen runs ahead of the miss-the-train Helen in real time, so a ribbon crosses whenever the film cuts back to the other life.
The shared prologue (#1) belongs to both lives; the hospital (#13) is where the two are shown in the same place at last.
Beat order within each line follows the film; the published plot summaries are brief, so a few placements are a judgement call.
legend_note: Left spine = the order the film screens its scenes. Right spine = the order they happen, with the two lifetimes numbered in parallel side by side, each in its own order.
